AccountHolder.description: A node representing an account holder in a search system.

BankAccount.description: A bank account holds money and is associated with a holder and a financial institution.

BankCard.description: A bank card used for making purchases.

CreditCard.description: A node representing a credit card with properties for balance, late payments, expiration date, security code, account number, and limit, and relationships to account holders and flagged cards.

FinancialInstitute.description: A financial institution that manages bank accounts.

Flagged.description: A node representing a flagged entity with personal information and financial details.

IP.description: A node representing an IP address, which can be located in a state and from which purchases have been made.

Login.description: A node representing a user's login information.

MoneyTransfer.description: A node representing a money transfer transaction between two bank accounts.

PhoneNumber.description: A node representing a phone number used in a search system.

Purchase.description: A node representing a purchase made by a customer.

SSN.description: A node representing a Social Security Number (SSN), used for identification purposes.

Shop.description: A node representing a shop in a search system.

State.description: A state is a geographical entity that is located within a country.

UnsecuredLoan.description: A node representing an unsecured loan with properties for account number, balance, loan amount, APR, and relationships to account holder, phone number, and flagged status.

_Bloom_Perspective_.description: A node representing a Bloom perspective with properties including version, roles, data, id, and name.

DELIVERED_AT.description: A relationship indicating when a purchase was delivered.

FOR_SHOP.description: A relationship indicating that a user has logged in to a specific shop.

FROM.description: A relationship type that connects a bank account to a financial institute.

FROM_IP.description: A relationship indicating the IP address from which a purchase was made.

HAS_ADDRESS.description: A relationship between an account holder and an address.

HAS_BANKACCOUNT.description: A relationship indicating that an account holder has a bank account.

HAS_CREDITCARD.description: A relationship between an account holder and a credit card.

HAS_PHONENUMBER.description: A relationship between an account holder and a phone number, which may be associated with an unsecured loan or flagged.

HAS_SSN.description: A relationship indicating that an account holder or flagged entity has a Social Security Number.

HAS_UNSECUREDLOAN.description: A relationship indicating that an account holder has an unsecured loan.

LOCATED_IN.description: A relationship indicating where an IP address is located.

SEND.description: Represents a transaction where money is sent from one bank account to another.

WITH.description: A relationship type that connects two nodes: MoneyTransfer and PhoneNumber, indicating that the MoneyTransfer has a phone number associated with it.

WITH_CARD.description: A relationship between a purchase and a bank card.

WITH_LOGIN.description: A relationship type that connects a purchase to a login.

AccountHolder.birthDate.description: The date of birth of the account holder.

AccountHolder.firstName.description: The first name of the account holder.

AccountHolder.lastName.description: The last name of the account holder.

AccountHolder.UniqueId.description: A unique identifier for the account holder.

AccountHolder.fullName.description: The full name of the account holder.

BankAccount.accountNumber.description: A unique identifier for the bank account.

BankAccount.balance.description: The current balance of the bank account.

BankAccount.lastReceived.description: The timestamp of the last transaction received.

BankAccount.lastSend.description: The timestamp of the last transaction sent.

BankCard.balance.description: The current balance on the card.

BankCard.latePayments.description: The number of late payments made on the card.

BankCard.expirationDate.description: The date when the card expires.

BankCard.securityCode.description: The security code on the card.

BankCard.accountNumber.description: The unique identifier for the card.

BankCard.limit.description: The maximum amount of money that can be charged to the card.

CreditCard.balance.description: The current balance of the credit card.

CreditCard.latePayments.description: The number of late payments made on the credit card.

CreditCard.expirationDate.description: The date when the credit card expires.

CreditCard.securityCode.description: The security code on the credit card.

CreditCard.accountNumber.description: The account number of the credit card.

CreditCard.limit.description: The credit limit of the credit card.

FinancialInstitute.website.description: The URL of the financial institution's website.

FinancialInstitute.name.description: The name of the financial institution.

Flagged.birthDate.description: The date of birth of the flagged entity.

Flagged.firstName.description: The first name of the flagged entity.

Flagged.lastName.description: The last name of the flagged entity.

Flagged.UniqueId.description: A unique identifier for the flagged entity.

Flagged.fullName.description: The full name of the flagged entity.

IP.ip.description: The IP address itself as a string.

Login.lastName.description: The last name of the user.

Login.mail.description: The email address of the user.

Login.startDate.description: The start date of the user's account.

Login.userid.description: The unique identifier for the user.

Login.firstName.description: The first name of the user.

PhoneNumber.phone.description: The actual phone number as a string.

PhoneNumber.provider.description: The service provider of the phone number.

PhoneNumber.touched.description: The number of times the phone number has been accessed.

Purchase.purchaseCode.description: A unique identifier for the purchase.

Purchase.time.description: The timestamp when the purchase was made.

Purchase.date.description: The date when the purchase was made.

Purchase.amount.description: The total amount of the purchase.

SSN.ssn.description: The unique identifier for the SSN.

Shop.shopID.description: The unique identifier for the shop.

UnsecuredLoan.accountNumber.description: The unique identifier for the loan account.

UnsecuredLoan.balance.description: The current balance of the loan.

UnsecuredLoan.loanAmount.description: The total amount of the loan.

UnsecuredLoan.APR.description: The annual percentage rate for the loan.

_Bloom_Perspective_.version.description: The version of the Bloom perspective.

_Bloom_Perspective_.roles.description: The roles associated with the Bloom perspective.

_Bloom_Perspective_.data.description: The data associated with the Bloom perspective.

_Bloom_Perspective_.id.description: The unique identifier of the Bloom perspective.

_Bloom_Perspective_.name.description: The name of the Bloom perspective.

WITH.lastUsed.description: The last time the MoneyTransfer was used with the associated PhoneNumber.
